note: Floors for the vault evidence gate over the frozen corpus and the blind evidence query set. Each floor sits one case (1/36) below the latest measurement, to absorb run-to-run GPU nondeterminism; a floor only ever rises.

chunk_head_snippet.note: Snippet = first 200 characters of the winning chunk; vault hits carry no line span.

query_selected_passage.note: Snippet = the reranker's best passage from each result's winning and runner-up chunks, with its file line span and section; fp16 reranker.
